purpose: Official Binance USD-M open-interest acquisition and integrity audit only; no signals, parameters, returns, or performance

timezone.normalization: Interpreted as UTC; output epoch seconds.
timezone.evidence: Official REST Open Interest Statistics documents a millisecond timestamp; static archive schema has a naive create_time string but does not explicitly specify its timezone.
timezone.status: UTC assumption; point-in-time use blocked pending explicit confirmation of the archive timezone and publication lag.

sources.archiveTimezoneEvidence: UTC is used as an evidenced working convention: the root audit found REST timestamp = UTC-interpreted create_time + 300 s for 11/11 overlapping non-midnight samples per asset (33 total, BTC/ETH/SOL; 2026-09-27). The 00:00 REST sample requires the prior archive day, which was outside that comparison. This is exploratory evidence, not a guarantee of a stable publication/alignment rule.
sources.publicationTimingEvidence: The official public-data repository documents daily archive availability on the following day; exact intraday publication time is not established here.

cadence.missingDataPolicy: Record absent days/gaps; exclude invalid or duplicate points; never interpolate.

checksumPolicy: Each ZIP SHA-256 must match Binance's adjacent official .CHECKSUM; cache files are immutable and changed official bytes are rejected.
rawFields: Full original ZIP CSV is retained unchanged; normalized JSON retains only time, sum_open_interest, sum_open_interest_value per symbol.

normalizationRevision.previousRule: Parsed timestamp/date and positive finite OI were retained unless duplicated; source seconds were not required to align to the 300-second grid.
normalizationRevision.newRule: Exclude any create_time whose seconds are not divisible by 300 or which has fractional seconds; never round or truncate.
